name: Bengaluru
tagline: Eternal-Spring Climate and Cosmopolitan Comforts in India's Tech Capital
description: Bengaluru is India's tech capital, a sprawling garden city where multinational offices, craft breweries, and leafy parks sit side by side. Its roughly 920-meter elevation delivers the mildest year-round climate of any major Indian metro, trading Delhi's extreme heat and Chennai's humidity for warm days and genuinely cool evenings. A large, well-established tech and returnee community keeps English widely spoken and international comforts — specialty coffee, imported groceries, global cuisine — easy to find. Legendary traffic congestion is the city's defining frustration, but for FIRE seekers chasing comfort and cosmopolitan amenities at Indian prices, Bengaluru is hard to beat.

quickFacts.visa: India has no retirement, pension, or passive-income visa. US citizens use the e-Tourist visa — 30-day (multiple-entry) or 1-year/5-year (multiple-entry; the 5-year fee rose from $80 to $200 in 2026) — and may stay up to 180 days per visit, with total time capped at 180 days per calendar year; long-term residents get by cycling visas in and out. The only path to living in India indefinitely is the OCI card, open to people of Indian origin or those married 2+ years to an Indian citizen or OCI holder.
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 75–150 Mbps typical; excellent fiber up to 1 Gbps
quickFacts.safetyRating: Generally safer than Delhi or Mumbai with low violent crime; heavy traffic is the real day-to-day danger
quickFacts.climate: Mild for the tropics thanks to ~920 m elevation — warm days, cool evenings, June–October monsoon

housing.description: Modest furnished 1BHK in a decent area (Jayanagar/HSR/BTM edge)

dining.description: Darshinis and casual restaurants most days; occasional café/craft-beer

healthcare.description: Individual mediclaim with Manipal/Fortis access — assumes an early retiree (45–55); older retirees should budget more

entertainment.description: Cubbon/Lalbagh, live music, Nandi Hills, gym

1M.lifestyle: A comfortable solo budget in India’s most temperate metro — a decent 1BHK, metro-and-auto mobility, darshini eating with regular café stops, and real individual cover. The near-constant spring climate keeps utilities the lowest of the metros; traffic is the daily tax.

housing.description: Spacious 3BR apartment in Indiranagar or a gated community in Whitefield

dining.description: Frequent dining at Indiranagar's buzzing restaurant row and Koramangala's cafes and microbreweries

healthcare.description: Premium insurance covering Manipal, Fortis, and Apollo hospital networks

transportation.description: Own small car or regular Uber/Ola, with the metro for convenience

entertainment.description: Craft breweries, live music, weekend getaways to Coorg and Chikmagalur, gym membership

2M.lifestyle: A spacious 3-bedroom apartment in Indiranagar or a gated community in Whitefield, dining regularly at Indiranagar's restaurant row and Koramangala's cafes and microbreweries, and your own small car or frequent Uber. Premium health insurance covering Manipal, Fortis, and Apollo hospitals. Weekend getaways to the coffee hills of Coorg or Chikmagalur are easy and affordable. Day-to-day life is comfortable with a solid financial cushion each month. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Good 1BHK / compact 2BHK in Indiranagar or Koramangala

dining.description: Regular fine-casual dining plus the celebrated brewery scene

transportation.description: Own small car or heavy ride-hail

3M.lifestyle: Cosmopolitan solo comfort — a good flat in Indiranagar or Koramangala, regular dining across one of India’s best restaurant/brewery scenes, a car or unlimited ride-hail, and weekend escapes to the coffee hills. English is spoken everywhere; imported comforts are easy to find.

housing.description: Expansive independent villa or penthouse in Indiranagar or a premium Whitefield gated community

dining.description: Personal chef for daily meals, fine dining several times per week, catered events

transportation.description: Luxury sedan with full-time chauffeur, domestic flights, occasional chartered travel

entertainment.description: Premium club memberships, art collecting, wellness retreats, luxury Western Ghats and Coorg getaways

5M.lifestyle: An expansive independent villa or penthouse in Indiranagar or a premium gated Whitefield community, a luxury sedan with full-time driver, and a housekeeper, cook, and gardener. Regular fine dining across the city and business-class flights for longer trips. Premium healthcare with a dedicated physician. Bengaluru's low costs relative to this budget mean a very large monthly margin, even living at the top end of the market. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large apartment or independent villa in Indiranagar / a gated Whitefield estate

dining.description: Fine dining several times a week, hotel restaurants

domesticHelp.description: Cook + housekeeper scaled to one home

10M.lifestyle: Solo luxury in the garden city — a large villa or premium flat, a driver, live-in cook and housekeeper, international health cover, and a generous travel budget. Bengaluru’s prime rents are India’s highest, so housing carries this tier; the temperate climate keeps utilities low even at scale.
